We're extending our free usage credits for Claude Code on the web, and they'll now expire on November 22 11:59 PM PT.

We heard your feedback that Claude Code on the web would occasionally hang. We’ve landed several reliability improvements over the past two weeks to address this, and are continuing to work on it. 

Let us know how it's working for you!
